messages.content:
/no_think
Return one compact JSON object with proposals array. For each proposal use claim_index (zero based), kind (stack_frame, grep_quote, definition_in_scope), arguments (all named tuple fields), polarity (positive or negative), modifiers (all causal, modal, quantifier and compound words), relation (supports, contradicts, unknown), and source_byte_start and source_byte_end as UTF-8 byte integers. Preserve every qualifier in the original answer. Use [] when uncertain.
